description:
## Problem
local-tpcdi-bundles-regenerate-current-generator was closed with acceptance 3 ('same-generator data/result-count comparisons') replaced by 'cross-generator comparison is prevented by the exclusion', and acceptance 4 ('site/cohort views checked') without evidence.

## Change
Compare row counts and query result counts across the 9 current-generator bundles from seed run 3096 at each scale and platform; check the Explorer cohort views show the new bundles and exclude the 12 flagged ones.

## Decision gates
None; read-only checks. A discrepancy becomes a defect item, not an edit here.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a table of per-table row counts and per-query result counts per bundle is recorded on this item with any differences explained; screenshots or fetched data from the deployed Explorer show the cohorts.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
